findings.text: The elif branch at line 86-89 sets ctx.set_parameter_source() but omits ctx._param_default_explicit[self.name] = self._default_explicit. When two options with explicit defaults share a parameter name and the first loses value arbitration (e.g., ctx.params was pre-populated), the second incorrectly wins because existing_default_explicit reads False instead of True, causing wrong value selection in feature-switch groups.
